rationale.consistency: Mirrors CookieFilter exactly: reuses cookieFilterAction, filterAction constants, hash(), OUTER-label loop, Validate, registration order and interface guards.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles no '=', quoted values, empty/unmatched names, non-array field, exact-case matching; but hand-rolled parser doesn't trim leading whitespace and is more lenient than net/http Set-Cookie parsing.
rationale.scope: Only adds the new filter, its registration and guards; no unrelated edits or refactors.
rationale.readability: Clear names and doc comments; parseSetCookieNameValue's five return values are a bit heavy but documented.
rationale.robustness: All slice indexing bounds-checked, no panics on malformed input, unparseable values pass through, non-array fields returned untouched.
rationale.maintainability: UnmarshalCaddyfile is a verbatim copy of CookieFilter's (~45 lines) rather than a shared helper; custom parser is small and isolated but diverges from stdlib semantics.
